contradicting_evidence: Stablecoin supply contraction across daily, weekly and monthly windows, together with weak ETH/BTC and the latest selloff, could develop into a persistent downside trend.
Positive Top-100 breadth and selective absolute altcoin gains could instead be early repair if they persist and gain support from stronger market leaders.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: No supported net weekly direction. Sustained repair and renewed contraction both remain viable; stabilization alone would not distinguish them. There is no evidence-based turning day or guaranteed late-week recovery.
falsification_conditions: Repeated observations establish rising BTC/ETH prices, stronger ETH/BTC, durable positive absolute breadth across capitalization proxies and corroborating fresh demand; that would establish an upside edge.
Repeated observations establish falling prices, worsening absolute breadth and persistent selling or liquidity contraction; that would establish a downside edge.
missing_evidence: A multi-session record of price structure, absolute breadth and ETH/BTC is needed to establish persistence over this horizon.
Fresh settled flows and evidence of liquidity deployment are needed to distinguish available stablecoin supply from actual risk-asset demand.
supporting_evidence: The supplied evidence contains conflicting conditions: short-term BTC/ETH selling alongside modestly positive 24h Top-100 participation.

Capitalization proxies do not show a coherent transmission sequence: large-alt median returns are positive, mid-alt median returns are negative, and the small-alt proxy median is only slightly positive.
Neither the lagged ETF and dominance observations nor the structural scenario establishes a durable week-ahead trajectory.
